stops.note: named the starchy root plant and the flatbread made from it
the Taíno baked the root into flat 'casabe' bread, which Spanish ships carried as provisions
stops.meaning: a starchy root crop and the bread made from it

stops.note: anglicized from Spanish/Portuguese accounts of Caribbean and South American agriculture

current_meaning: a starchy tropical root vegetable, a staple food crop also known as manioc or yuca
